purpose: Teach: 山上/川本/和泉/玉田/三枝/寺田/岩井/しのぎ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご友人の山上さんと釣りに行かれた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to go fishing with his friend Yamagami.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic voice. Gazes into distance. Steady, unhurried pacing. A quiet tenderness as he speaks the memory aloud—almost to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、川本兄さんとお酒を酌み交わされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and when Grandpa was young, he and his brother Kawamoto used to share a drink together, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial tone. A gentle tease beneath the affection. Slightly sing-song cadence on the recollection, like she's turning the memory over between them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが和泉さんと文通された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to exchange letters with Izumi.
lines.style: Same wistful quality as before. Slight pause before the name—reaching back into time. Softer attack, as if speaking a secret he wants to keep alive.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご友人の玉田さんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, didn't you play shogi with your friend Tamada?
lines.style: Lyrical, gently correcting lilt. A knowing smile in her voice. Leaning in with familiarity—this is their rhythm now, these paired memories.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお兄様の三枝さんと旅行された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he took a trip with his older brother Saegusa.
lines.style: Same measured, reaching-back quality. Slight breath before the brother's name. Lingering on the word 'trip' as if seeing the dusty road they walked.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご縁あった寺田さんと俳句を詠まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, didn't you compose haiku with Terada—the one you were fated to meet?
lines.style: Delighted, whimsical delivery. 'Fated' lands with gentle emphasis—romantic nostalgia. Warm, wrapped-in-memory tone. Trailing off with affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが岩井さんと囲碁を打たれた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to play go with Iwai.
lines.style: Quietest yet. Almost reverent. Long, held pause at the beginning. Each name placed like a stone on a board. Breath full and deliberate.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご商売のしのぎを削られた時代があったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, wasn't there a time when you and your friends competed fiercely in business?
lines.style: A shift here—warmer, more present. Still affectionate, but with deeper recognition. A gentle nod to his sacrifice and his seasons. Close and intimate.
